name: Norma Olmos
office: Baldwin Park Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Norma Olmos is the president of the Baldwin Park Unified School District Board of Education. She was elected in 2024 to a term ending in 2026. She previously served on the City of Baldwin Park Parks and Recreation Commission. She also served on the district's Citizen's Oversight Committee, which supervised a high school gym project.
